correctness.rationale: For the conditional density on (0,t), Cauchy-Schwarz gives integral g_t^2 >= 1/t. The negative one-half factor yields past extropy <= -1/(2t), forcing divergence to -infinity as t decreases to zero. This directly contradicts global nonincreasing behavior for any finite value at a fixed positive time.
